result.instructions: Tools for ViralSweep, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my ViralSweep brands and their active promotions."; "Find entrants matching this email address in a promotion."; "Show existing winners and prize titles for this promotion.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ViralSweep data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run viralsweep_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run viralsweep_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run viralsweep_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. viralsweep_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: viralsweep_list_brands
tools.title: List ViralSweep brands
tools.description: Read account brands. Offset/limit page a bounded vendor response locally; no vendor-native pagination is claimed.

tools.name: viralsweep_list_promotions
tools.title: List ViralSweep promotions
tools.description: Read promotions for a brand, optionally active or archived. Offset/limit page a bounded vendor response locally.

tools.name: viralsweep_list_entries
tools.title: Read ViralSweep promotion entries
tools.description: Read one vendor page of entrants, their emails and entry/referral counts. Optional query searches email addresses. Login links and arbitrary form fields are excluded.

tools.name: viralsweep_list_winners
tools.title: Read ViralSweep winners
tools.description: Read a promotion's winners and prize titles, optionally filtered by Unix timestamps. Reads existing winners without selecting new ones. Offset/limit page a bounded response locally; private login and prize redemption codes are excluded.
